title: Enforce key-only pilot SSH administration
evidence_required: FT-003-AC-018 RED: pilot SSH policy has no source-managed focused proof; GREEN: effective SSH configuration accepts key authentication for facemoment, rejects password authentication, and gives the display user no SSH access, while the authorized operator remains able to run the recovery preconditions; decisive comparison: scripts/check-ssh-policy.sh records effective sshd values plus positive facemoment-key and negative password/display probes without changing keys; artifact: redacted inspection under .tasks/TASK-064-T3-FT-003-W1/.
purpose: Own only the pilot host's key-only administrative SSH boundary.
success_outcome: Authorized facemoment key access remains available while password and display-user SSH are denied.
anti_goals: Do not rotate/delete operator keys or lock out the operator.
Do not change browser sandbox, LNA policy or network port exposure.
Do not grant display SSH/sudo/Docker access.

forbidden_scope: Browser/LNA/port controls owned by other tasks
Any destructive account or SSH reconfiguration
stop_conditions: Effective configuration cannot be observed safely.
Display-user denial requires permission expansion elsewhere.

constraints: Use source-managed SSH policy plus a read-only focused check.
Never replace/delete existing authorized keys during proof.
invariants: Password authentication and display-user SSH are denied.
Operator access is not destructively changed by verification.
verification_targets: Positive key-only facemoment and negative password/display probes.
